expiry.days: In {count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}

plan.apiKeys: API keys and service accounts need the Pro plan or above.
plan.webhooks: Webhooks need the Pro plan or above.

key.title: Copy this key now
key.body: This is the only time the key is shown. Store it in your server's secret store; we keep only a fingerprint of it.

token.title: Copy this token now
token.body: This is the only time the token is shown. It acts as you, limited to the areas you chose. Keep it private.

webhook.title: Copy the signing secret now
webhook.body: Use it to check the XOS-Signature header of each delivery. This is the only time it is shown.

serviceAccounts.title: Service accounts
serviceAccounts.description: A service account is a member for your servers. API keys act as one, with the role you give it.

retireConfirm.title: Retire {name}?
retireConfirm.body: Its API keys stop working at once and its membership ends. This cannot be undone.

serviceAccounts.roleHelp: Choose a role you hold every capability of. The Owner role is never offered.

apiKeys.title: API keys
apiKeys.description: Keys let your servers call the XOS API as a service account. Each key is limited to the areas you choose and expires within a year.
apiKeys.noAccount: no service account (cannot call the API)

revokeConfirm.title: Revoke {name}?
revokeConfirm.body: Requests with this key fail from now on. Create a new key to replace it.

apiKeys.needsAccount: Add a service account first: every key acts as one.
apiKeys.scopesHelp: Areas are capability groups. The key can never do more than its service account's role allows.

tokens.title: Personal API tokens
tokens.description: A token lets your own scripts call the XOS API as you, in this organization, limited to the areas you choose.
tokens.off: Your organization does not allow personal API tokens. An Admin can turn them on in Settings, API Keys and Service Accounts.
tokens.scopesHelp: Only areas you hold a capability in are offered. The token can never do more than you can.

revokeConfirm.title: Revoke {name}?
revokeConfirm.body: Scripts using this token stop working at once.

tokens.orgOn: Members may create personal tokens. You can revoke any of them.
tokens.orgOff: Personal tokens are off, so none of these work. Turn on Allow personal API tokens above to let members create them.
tokens.orgNone: No member has a personal token.

webhooks.title: Webhook endpoints
webhooks.description: XOS sends a signed POST to each endpoint when an event it subscribes to happens, and retries for up to 72 hours.
webhooks.needsCapability: Only people who manage webhooks see the endpoints.

removeConfirm.title: Remove this endpoint?
removeConfirm.body: {url} gets no further deliveries. Its delivery history stays.

webhooks.urlHelp: A public HTTPS address. Private and internal hosts are refused.

deliveries.title: Recent deliveries
deliveries.description: The last 20 deliveries to your endpoints. Send one again to deliver the same event as a new delivery.

spend.title: Spend limits
spend.description: Who may approve how much, per document type and currency. Approvals above a limit are refused, and amounts above the dual approval line need a second approver.
spend.none: No limits yet, so nobody can approve spend documents.
spend.narrowed: Limited to one account or cost center
spend.selfGrant: Nobody can set a limit that applies to themselves, so the Owner role's limit is set by another Owner.

removeConfirm.title: Remove this limit?
removeConfirm.body: {holder} can no longer approve under it. A removed limit cannot be restored.

spend.dualHelp: Leave blank for one approver at every amount.

sod.title: Rules every organization keeps
sod.description: Separation of duties: one person never does both halves of these acts. The database enforces each rule, for every organization.
sod.tighten: No rule can be switched off. Approval policies add more approvers where you need them, and the stricter options below add checks.

options.title: Stricter options
options.description: Your organization can make separation of duties stricter, never looser. Each option you turn on adds a check on top of the rules every organization keeps.
options.readOnly: Only someone who can tighten separation of duties turns these options on or off.

offConfirm.title: Turn off this option?
offConfirm.body: {option} The rules every organization keeps stay on.

names.sod_change_order_requester_steps: The requester of a change order cannot decide any step of its approval.
names.sod_document_creator: Whoever created a purchase order, change order, invoice, requisition, expense, payroll run or settlement cannot approve it or decide a step of its approval.
names.sod_receiver_po_approver: Goods are received by someone other than a person who approved the purchase order or a change to it.

customFields.title: Custom fields
customFields.description: Fields your organization adds to built-in records, such as projects and venues. Values are typed and checked.

removeConfirm.title: Remove {label}?
removeConfirm.body: The field leaves every record. Values already entered are kept for the retention period.

customFields.label: Label
customFields.keyHelp: Used by the API and imports. Leave blank to make one from the label. It never changes.
customFields.typeHelp: The type never changes once the field exists.
customFields.filterableHelp: Adds an index so views can filter by it.

canon.title: Your organization's extensions
canon.description: Disciplines and categories your organization adds to the canon. Members propose them on the Canon page and another person decides.
canon.counts: {approved} approved, {proposed} waiting for a decision, {closed} rejected or withdrawn.
canon.none: No extensions approved or waiting yet.
canon.open: Propose and decide extensions on the Canon page

automations.title: What runs on its own
automations.description: Work your organization set to happen without anyone pressing a button. Each is managed where it lives.
automations.recurring: {count, plural, =0 {No recurring records} one {# recurring record} other {# recurring records}}
automations.recurringHelp: Records that repeat on a schedule.
automations.policies: {count, plural, =0 {No active approval policies} one {# active approval policy} other {# active approval policies}}
automations.policiesHelp: Route documents to the right approvers in order.
automations.webhooks: {count, plural, =0 {No live webhook endpoints} one {# live webhook endpoint} other {# live webhook endpoints}}
automations.webhooksHelp: Tell your other systems when events happen.
automations.reportsDescription: Reports emailed on a schedule, in the time zone each schedule names.
automations.noReports: No scheduled reports you can see.

departments.title: Departments and disciplines in use
departments.description: Choose the canon departments and disciplines your organization works in. Department pickers then offer only these.
departments.all: None chosen yet, so every department is offered.
departments.chosen: {departments, plural, one {# department} other {# departments}} and {disciplines, plural, one {# discipline} other {# disciplines}} in use.
departments.departmentsHelp: Clearing a department also clears its disciplines.
departments.extensionsDescription: Approved extensions are in use by definition.

locations.title: New venue defaults
locations.description: What a new venue starts with. People can still change them for each venue; venues already saved keep their own.
locations.jurisdictionHelp: Decides which permit and code questions apply.
locations.timeZoneHelp: Times typed for the venue are read in it.
locations.browserZone: The time zone of the person's device

usage.metersDescription: Counted per billing month (UTC). The open month grows until it closes and is reported.
usage.metersHidden: Only people who can read usage see the meters.

privacy.requestsDescription: Requests from people to see, correct, move or erase their data. Each is due 30 days after it arrives, 90 if you extend it.
privacy.requestsHidden: Only people who manage data requests see them.
privacy.moveBody: Say why. The reason is kept with the request's history.
privacy.holdsDescription: A hold keeps data from being purged or deleted while a matter is open. It is never edited, only released.
privacy.holdsHidden: Only people who manage legal holds see them.
privacy.releaseBody: Normal retention applies again from now. A released hold cannot be placed again; place a new one if needed.
privacy.matterHelp: The case or request the hold is for.
privacy.exportsDescription: The full organization archive and exports of views. A Restricted column needs a second factor to export.
privacy.toArchive: Download the full archive from the Danger Zone
privacy.classificationDescription: Every column is classified. The class decides who may read and export it.
privacy.classCounts: {public} Public, {internal} Internal, {confidential} Confidential and {restricted} Restricted columns.
privacy.retentionDescription: How long the platform keeps each kind of data before it is purged, unless a legal hold keeps it.
privacy.retentionMore: {count} tables have a retention period; these are the ones people ask about most.
privacy.toMessageRetention: Message retention is set in Communication

audit.title: Latest audit events
audit.description: Every sensitive change is recorded with who made it and from where.
audit.hidden: Only people who can read the audit log see its events.
audit.retention: Audit events are kept for seven years.

connectedApps.title: Connected apps
connectedApps.description: Apps you allowed to act for you. Each can do only what you can, in the areas you approved.
connectedApps.none: You have not connected any apps.

payout.title: Payout details
payout.description: Where each organization pays you. Details are entered with that organization's payment provider; only the last four digits show here.

tax.title: Tax forms
tax.description: Forms you signed for organizations that pay you. They are signed during onboarding for an engagement.

workspace.noMembers: Nobody is assigned to this workspace yet.

team.noMembers: Nobody is on this team yet.
team.settingsNone: No setting is set per team yet: a team follows its workspace and the organization. Team audiences in feeds, schedules and notifications use this team's members.

errors.conflict: That name or key is already in use.
errors.invalid: Something entered is not valid. Check the fields and try again.
errors.unexpected: That did not save. Try again in a moment.
errors.plan_feature_required: Your plan does not include this. See Billing and Plan.
errors.api_key_scope_unknown: One of the areas is not a capability group.
errors.api_key_expiry_invalid: Choose an expiry within one year.
errors.api_key_service_account_invalid: Choose a service account of this organization.
errors.service_account_role_unknown: Choose a role you hold every capability of; never the Owner role.
errors.service_account_owner_role: A service account cannot take the Owner role.
errors.service_account_name_invalid: Name the service account in 1 to 200 characters.
errors.service_account_expiry_invalid: Choose an expiry in the future.
errors.grant_exceeds_holder: You can only give a role whose every capability you hold.
errors.role_band: You cannot give a role above your own.
errors.personal_tokens_off: Your organization does not allow personal API tokens.
errors.personal_token_name: Name the token in 1 to 200 characters.
errors.personal_token_scopes: Choose at least one area the token may use.
errors.personal_token_scope_not_held: A token can only use areas you hold a capability in.
errors.personal_token_expiry: Choose an expiry within one year.
errors.personal_token_limit: You already have 10 active tokens here. Revoke one first.
errors.step_up_required: Confirm it is you with your second factor, then try again.
errors.webhook_private_host: Use a public HTTPS address; private and internal hosts are refused.
errors.webhook_delivery_not_in_flight: This delivery cannot be sent again now.
errors.sod_self_grant: You cannot set a limit that applies to yourself. Ask another Owner or Admin.
errors.custom_field_type_immutable: A field's type never changes. Add a new field instead.
errors.custom_field_key_immutable: A field's key never changes. Add a new field instead.
errors.plan_limit_exceeded: Your plan's limit is reached. See Billing and Plan.
errors.dsar_transition_not_allowed: A request cannot move to that state from where it is.
errors.dsar_state_conflict: Someone moved this request first. Reload to see where it is.
errors.legal_hold_table_unknown: Choose data that has a retention period.
errors.legal_hold_immutable: A hold is never edited, only released.
errors.department_unknown: One of the departments is not in the canon.
errors.discipline_unknown: One of the disciplines is not in the canon.
errors.jurisdiction_unknown: Choose a jurisdiction from the canon.
errors.time_zone_unknown: Choose a time zone from the list.
errors.separation_option_unknown: Only a stricter option can be turned on or off. The rules every organization keeps are always on.

fieldErrors.name: Enter a name of up to 200 characters.
fieldErrors.url: Enter a public address that starts with https://.
fieldErrors.holder: Choose who the limit is for.
fieldErrors.limit: Enter an amount, for example 2500 or 2500.00.
fieldErrors.dualAbove: Enter an amount, or leave it blank.
fieldErrors.target: Choose the records the field goes on.
fieldErrors.label: Enter a label of up to 100 characters.
fieldErrors.key: Use lowercase letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter.
fieldErrors.next: Choose where the request goes next.
fieldErrors.reason: Say why, in up to 500 characters.
fieldErrors.matter: Name the matter in up to 300 characters.

gateway.noTokens: You have no personal API tokens.
gateway.tokensOff: None of your organizations allows personal API tokens.
gateway.regionsHelp: Where your company works, as canon jurisdictions. Organizations filter by them when they look for vendors.
gateway.capabilitiesHelp: What your company offers, as canon categories. They show on your public company profile.
gateway.defaultsHelp: What your team members receive from the organizations they work with until they choose for themselves.
gateway.defaultsOwn: Each person's own choice in Settings, Notifications always wins.
gateway.defaultsReadOnly: An Account Owner or Admin sets these. Your own choice in Settings, Notifications always wins.
gateway.madeOwner: They are now an Account Owner.
gateway.makeOwnerHelp: To hand ownership over, make someone an Account Owner, then step down.
gateway.lastOwner: You are the only Account Owner. Make someone else an Account Owner before you step down or leave.
gateway.leaveBody: You lose access to the company's engagements, documents and payouts at once. Your own profile stays.
